g.text: SD03 - Invoice output and unpaid invoice handling (UC16 / UC18 / AD16 / AD18)
Use actually delivered items, not unfulfilled order lines.
Invoice shows date, invoice number, customer billing address,
quantities, unit prices and line totals, total excl. VAT,
9% VAT, total incl. VAT, order discount,
total after order discount, one-time discount,
total after one-time discount, customer discount,
further orders blocked until full payment
